review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: Creature mouth part (PROPOSED): a snake-like wide lipped mouth with two long curved front fangs and a forked tongue; opens to strike and flicks its tongue on shape keys.

textures.name: T_PartMouthFangs_Albedo
textures.packing: greyscale albedo detail (baked AO darkens crevices), times each material's base colour

textures.name: T_PartMouthFangs_ORM
textures.packing: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

handles.meaning: the lower jaw drops about 34 degrees and the fangs swing forward to strike
the forked tongue flicked 4 cm further out, its tines spread and lifted

part_rules.handles_note: H1_Open is on all four meshes (MouthFangsLower drops on its hinge, MouthFangs lifts 5 degrees, MouthFangsFangs swing forward about 55 degrees from their roots, MouthFangsTongue drops with the lower jaw); H2_Tongue is on MouthFangsTongue only.

reduction.method: Blender collapse decimation within a surface tolerance; full-detail shading baked to the normal map

review_notes.gate1_shape: pass: a short, wide, low snout of lips (13.1 cm across, 6.5 cm deep, standing 7.5 cm out of the skin) resting a little open over a shorter lower jaw; face-on (gray_top, the in-game front) it reads as a wide lens of a mouth with two long fangs hanging from the upper jaw's front in front of the chin and curving back, and the forked tongue between the lips; from the side the mouth line is a dark slot with the fangs crossing it at the tip. H1_Open drops the lower jaw about 34 degrees and swings the fangs forward to strike; H2_Tongue flicks the tongue about 4 cm out and spreads its fork. Iterated: the first icosphere jaws were 1518 triangles, so the jaws are lathed domes with rings crowded at the lip edge (909 now).
review_notes.gate2_materials: pass: three finishes - teal skin of domed snake scales with crisp grooves (larger plates and a slightly paler tone along the mouth line, which reads only faintly in the gap's shade), ivory fangs with fine lengthwise streaks, and a dark plum wet mouth and tongue (low chroma, LAB hue 334, clear of the threat pink). Iterated: the first scale shader read as cracked mud.
review_notes.gate3_neutral_light: pass: under the neutral white rig the scales' domes catch soft highlights, the fangs stay bright without clipping and the tongue's fork reads against the sky; the mouth slot is dark but not crushed.
review_notes.gate4_godot: needs revision: orientation only, from the shared forward_cone frame (not this art). On the stalker (mandibles swapped in memory, after_stalker_mouth_fangs_eye_turret.jpg) it loads, seats under the head without floating or deep clipping and keeps its teal scales, ivory fangs and plum tongue, but its opening faces up. With the frame fix previewed (conefix_stalker_mouth_fangs_eye_turret.jpg) the fangs hang down in front of the chin and the forked tongue pokes out ahead, reading as a snake's mouth in the close view; at the world camera's distance on this spider-like body it is a small teal shape under the head, partly behind the forelegs, and the fangs are only a few pixels.

provenance: Authored procedurally in Blender by tools/blender/make_more_creature_parts.py, with helpers from tools/blender/make_creature_parts.py; no external or generated meshes. Textures baked in Blender from procedural shaders.
